title: Camp followers
html:
Camp followers are characters who travel with the party and often remain at camp.

Overview

Unlike companions, they cannot be asked to join the party. They usually fulfill certain roles, such as resurrecting dead party members or providing lore.

Locations

Permanent

  •  Arnell Hallowleaf – imprisoned in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace
  •  Emmeline Hallowleaf – imprisoned in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace
  •  Mizora – loitering outside the grand hall of Wyrm's Rock Fortress, provided she was rescued from the Mind Flayer Colony
  •  Ulder Ravengard – imprisoned in the Iron Throne
  •  Volo
    • Act One – is first located in the Emerald Grove, but does not join the party's campsite unless freed from the Goblin Camp
    • Act Three – tied to a rail cart at the Grey Harbour Docks
  •  Withers – in a sarcophagus within the Dank Crypt
  •  Yenna – at the entrance to Rivington
  • Zombie  Astarion – in Cazador's Dungeon[6]

Temporary

  •  Arabella – in front of the House of Healing graveyard, provided ⁠Save Arabella was completed
  •  Aylin – if not killed by  Shadowheart, moves to the ground floor of Moonrise Towers after  Ketheric Thorm is defeated
  •  Barcus Wroot – Grymforge, provided ⁠Rescue the Gnome was completed
  •  Isobel Thorm – if not kidnapped at the Last Light Inn, moves to the ground floor of Moonrise Towers after Ketheric Thorm is defeated

Animals

  •  Owlbear Cub – at the chicken chasing course in the Goblin Camp after interacting with or killing the Owlbear in the Owlbear Nest.
  •  Scratch – northeast of Moonhaven, guarding Gomwick's corpse
  •  Grub – joins with Yenna

Notes

  1. ↑ 1.0 1.1 Requires Shadowheart to be in the party
  2. ↑ Requires Wyll to be in the party
  3. ↑ After performing surgery on a party member or reaching Rivington, Volo leaves camp; he later journeys to the Lower City and, if rescued there, returns to camp for the rest of the game
  4. ↑ Withers joins the camp automatically once the story progresses to a certain point if not first released from his sarcophagus[verify]
  5. ↑ Yenna and Grub join the camp even if rejected
  6. ↑ 6.0 6.1 If the party fails to save Astarion from Cazador Szarr but casts  Revivify on him at camp, he stays at his tent as a Zombie
  7. ↑ Leaves camp when the party exits Act Two
  8. ↑ 8.0 8.1 Aylin and Isobel join camp after Ketheric's defeat, and leave after Lorroakan is killed; if Aylin is handed over to Lorroakan, Isobel dies in an attempt to free her
  9. ↑ Leaves camp after the party reaches Last Light Inn
  10. ↑ Can be rescued from the Shadowfell by Halsin as part of ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse; he leaves when the party exits Act Two
  11. ↑ Appears to Paladins who have broken their oath and remains unless paid to renew it
  12. ↑ Tara joins camp automatically if Gale is selected as an origin character
  13. ↑ Grub joins the camp automatically with Yenna. Grub leaves camp if Yenna is killed by Orin during ⁠Rescue Orin's Victim if she kidnaps Lae'zel, and is killed if Orin kidnaps Yenna
